Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary on parent_molregno to retrieve children (salts) and include the parent row. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno. Join compound_records to activities on record_id. Join compound_records to docs on doc_id. Join activities to assays on assay_id. Join activities to target_dictionary on tid. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter molecule_dictionary.chembl_id equals CHEMBL376359 or parent_molregno matches the molregno of CHEMBL376359. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id equals CHEMBL284. Filter activities.standard_type equals IC50. Filter activities.standard_units equals nM. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
